angle: C-80's own verdict taken as the design's first premise: no pure-Gamma falloff exists; reach and falloff belong to the coupling, i.e. to the bath. Anything at separation that feels written content feels it THROUGH the shared environment (F-17/F-18: the bath holds record information above a weight-d threshold). So the instrument is built around the bath as the medium: a probe coupled ONLY to the bath, never to the carrier, reading the record-conditioned bath state at its own location. The mean-force route (Casimir/dispersion-style induced energy) is how real fields present themselves in open-system physics, and it extends C-47's mean-force potential from source-evaluated to probe-evaluated — which is precisely the limitation C-47 is registered with.
name: THE HANGING CLOCK — a bath-suspended two-level clock reading the two-lump induced free energy at earned separation
summary: A single two-level probe with a nonzero energy splitting (a clock — the splitting is mandatory, see below) hangs off the bath at a declared bath site, coupled only to bath operators, never to the carrier. The bath is given declared internal structure (a finite interaction graph — the medium), and the carrier couples to the bath at a separate contact region through a record-visible (weight >= d, per F-17) coupling. The observable is the exact four-term Casimir-style subtraction E_ind(s, j) = F(both lumps) - F(source only) - F(probe only) + F(bath alone) — O-39's own named minimum, the two-lump induced energy as a function of separation — computed exactly and compared written vs unwritten under D-15 controls, with the separation dependence's SHAPE an output, never an input. A scratchpad feasibility run (toric-sector-reduced, 7-site chain medium + probe, exact eigh) shows the record contrast is resolvable at every separation tested (1.3e-1 at contact to 3.3e-3 at bath distance 6, against an unwritten control that decays to ~1e-7) and computed one binding design fact: a degenerate probe is exactly gauged away (contrast ~1e-14), so the probe must be a clock.
probe: One two-level system P with H_P = (Omega/2) Z_P, Omega != 0 — the splitting is not a convenience but a computed requirement: at Omega = 0 the sector flip s -> -s composes with a bath gauge transformation and g -> -g into an exact isospectrality, and the record contrast is machine zero (verified in the feasibility run; this is O-11's asymmetric-bath lesson recurring at the probe). P couples as g * Z_P (x) B_j where B_j is a declared single-site bath operator at bath site j — support disjoint from the carrier and from the source-contact region, [H_int^probe, anything on the carrier] = 0 identically by construction. State: thermal for the induced-energy reading (the static instrument); prepared in |+> for the companion dynamical reading. "Away" is stated in earned distance: the C-78/C-80 instrument (w_min = minimal admissible-writer weight connecting two regions = earned separation) extended to the joint venue carrier (x) local bath — the venue where the amended clauses already live (O-51). This extension is the ONE new concept that must be earned: re-run the C-78 axioms battery (identity, symmetry, triangle, indiscernibles, with a failing control on the same instrument) for d_sep(probe contact, source contact) on the joint interaction graph before any separation claim is registered. If the extension fails to be a metric, the design says so and the result is scoped to declared bath-graph distance, registered as UNEARNED.
observable: E_ind(s, j; beta) = F_{s, probe@j} - F_s(no probe) - F_{probe@j}(no source coupling) + F_0(bath alone), each F = -(1/beta) ln Tr exp(-beta H) computed by exact dense diagonalization — units: energy, the same units as C-47's Phi. Derived readings: (a) the RECORD CONTRAST Delta(j) = E_ind(written, j) - E_ind(unwritten, j), the field-side number; (b) the discrete difference of Delta across earned-separation steps, units energy per unit d_sep — the first force-shaped quantity in the program that is read at a place where the source is not; (c) companion dynamical readings on the same venue with the same probe: chi(record : probe) via Environment.holevo (does a bath-only-coupled object at separation come to HOLD record information, or does F-17's threshold block information while energy responds — that split, if it appears, is itself new registrable structure), and the probe's dephasing function under |+> preparation (owners named below).
response_claim: The claim is existence and measurability, never shape: (1) PRESENCE — Delta(j) != 0 beyond contact (j with d_sep >= 2) for written content, against an unwritten surface whose reading is computed beside it; (2) AMOUNT — Delta varies with m, the number of written records coupled in (toric 2x2 has two logical records Zbar1, Zbar2; sweep m = 0, 1, 2 lumps at fixed total coupling budget, plus multi-lump venues at larger L if the m-dependence is degenerate at m <= 2); (3) SEPARATION — Delta varies with d_sep, and the functional form of that variation is LOGGED AS OUTPUT with no fit to any assumed family on any verdict path. The feasibility run already exhibits a sign-alternating, non-monotone shape (a parity effect of the chain medium) — a shape no gravity-shaped prior would permit, which is exactly why D-1 must and does stay out of the verdict logic. No exponent, no 1/r, no monotonicity is required anywhere; every verdict is a computed boolean on pre-registered tolerances that can come out the other way (D-8), and the exploratory scratchpad numbers are expressly NOT the lane's expected values — the lane re-runs on fresh declared parameters.
controls: (D-15, four, all computed beside the measurement) C1 UNWRITTEN SURFACE: same instrument, carrier unwritten (even sector mixture at the free-energy level, and separately lam = 0); the feasibility run shows this control has real teeth — unwritten reads ~1e-7 where written reads ~1e-3. C2 PROBE-ONLY: g != 0, lam = 0; the four-term subtraction must return machine zero, validating the subtraction itself. C3 COUPLING-ARTIFACT (the one that catches the instrument lying): replace the source coupling by a RECORD-BLIND operator of identical norm and identical support — A = Xbar (commutes with the writer; O-11's symmetry control gives exactly zero) and separately a stabilizer coupling; any surviving Delta is an artifact of coupling energetics, not of written content, and the verdict fails. Plus the F-17 weight-1 variant: a weight-1 source coupling entangles carrier and bath but transfers zero record bits, so the probe reading under weight-1 coupling isolates the coupling artifact from the record-borne part by subtraction. C4 POSITIVE CONTROL FOR EVERY ZERO: wherever a contrast is claimed zero (C3, the Omega = 0 gauge null), the same instrument shows the nonzero reading at the neighboring parameter — already demonstrated in the feasibility table.
venue: First venue: toric 2x2 carrier (dim 256, d = 2, records Zbar1/Zbar2, the canonical benchmark), record-diagonal source coupling lam * Zbar (x) B_0 which commutes with H_C, so the carrier sector is a good quantum number and the venue SECTOR-REDUCES exactly: all four free energies computed on bath+probe alone (2^(nB+1)-dim) with s-dependent contact fields — nB = 8 costs 512-dim eigh, milliseconds, exact. The sector reduction is verified, not assumed: one full unconditioned run at nB = 3 (dim 256 x 8 x 2 = 4096, one dense eigh, seconds) must match the reduced numbers to tolerance before the reduced instrument is trusted. Bath medium: declared finite chain (later: declared 2D patch) with internal hopping and asymmetric site fields, all parameters swept on a declared grid (h, beta, Omega, lam, g) — the medium is INSERTED and said so, exactly as C-80's coupling was. Machinery reused: model/record_model.py (Environment, holevo, formation/evolve for the dynamical companion), LANE_O11_MEANFORCE's closed-form cross-check pattern, LANE_F1_ARROW's threshold instrument. Compute budget: the entire static instrument at nB <= 10 runs in minutes on this machine; smaller and exact, as required.
meaning: Pre-registered three-way reading. (A) FIELD SIDE EXISTS: V1 (Delta != 0 beyond contact) AND V2 (separation dependence exists) AND C3 clean AND C2 zero — the record surface has a field side: an object coupled only to the environment, at earned separation, reads a record-dependent, separation-dependent energy. O-39's stated minimum (two-lump induced energy vs separation) is then in hand, and O-39 moves from OPEN to answered-in-part, with metric/connection/deflection named as the NEXT earning targets (a two-contact probe reading a level-shift gradient — a tidal instrument — is the natural successor). (B) FIELD SIDE EXISTS BUT IS THE MEDIUM'S: Delta != 0 but every structural feature of Delta(j, m) is reproducible by the declared medium with the record replaced by a fixed boundary condition of matched strength (a computed swap test, in-lane): then the division of labor extends one level up — Gamma gives sources, the coupling/bath gives reach AND the field's shape — consistent with C-77's fixed shape, and O-39 refines rather than closes; record-owned structure would then be hunted in the m-dependence and in dependence on WHICH record is written under symmetric contact arrangement. (C) NO FIELD SIDE: on the full declared sweep grid, every beyond-contact Delta is below tolerance while all positive controls fire — C-80's zero-beyond-contact verdict repeats one level up through the bath, and O-39 closes negatively for the mean-force class; the named next step is then the dynamical channel alone (information flow without energy response) or the register records that the surface has no field side in this class. Under feedback_classical_nulls: a null here reads two ways and is registered so.
borrowed: Every borrowing names its program variable FIRST (relevance test): (1) Phi, C-47's own mean-force potential — extended from source-evaluated to probe-evaluated; owners: Kirkwood (potential of mean force), mean-force Gibbs state literature (Trushechkin; Miller-Anders). (2) The two-lump induced energy O-39 itself names — the four-term subtraction; owners: Casimir 1948, London dispersion forces; bath-mediated induced interactions are the textbook mechanism by which real fields act between uncharged probes, which is exactly this angle's premise. (3) chi(record : bath fragment), the program's own F-17 instrument (Holevo), applied to the probe as a fragment; owner: Holevo, already owned in-lane. (4) The pure-dephasing/Ramsey probe for the dynamical companion — maps to the probe readout of the record-conditioned bath state; owners: Ramsey; Cucchietti-Paz-Zurek decoherence probes; quantum probe thermometry (Correa et al.). (5) The declared bath graph (chain/patch medium) — maps to C-80's declared coupling term, the licensed carrier of reach; owner lineage: Caldeira-Leggett open-system baths, here finite and exact. The bath graph's distance is the one geometric import, and it is either earned by the C-78 battery on the joint venue or registered UNEARNED with the result scoped.
first_computation: One script, sector-reduced venue, exact dense eigh throughout. Carrier: toric 2x2, record Zbar, source coupling lam * Zbar (x) X_0 (weight d = 2 on the carrier, record-diagonal). Bath: open chain nB = 8, H_B = sum_k w_k Z_k + h sum_k (X_k X_{k+1} + Y_k Y_{k+1}), asymmetric declared fields w_k. Probe: H_P = (Omega/2) Z_P, coupling g * Z_P (x) X_j, j = 1..7. Declared grid: beta in {1, 2, 4}, h in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}, Omega in {0 (gauge control), 0.9}, lam = 0.6, g = 0.3, tolerances tol_zero = 1e-10 against machine-zero controls. Compute the table E_ind(s, j) for s = +1, -1, unwritten-mixture, plus all four controls (C1-C4) and the nB = 3 full-venue verification of the sector reduction (dim 4096, one eigh). Output decides: V1 = [max_j>=2 |Delta(j)| > tol] (existence beyond contact), V2 = [Delta not constant over j] (separation dependence), V3 = [record-blind coupling contrast < tol] (artifact clean), V4 = [probe-only E_ind < tol] (subtraction valid), V5 = [sector reduction matches full venue < tol]. V1 AND V2 AND V3 AND V4 AND V5 sends the design to the m-sweep and the earned-separation battery; any failure routes to the pre-registered three-way reading. In parallel, the earning step: run the C-78 metric-axioms battery on d_sep over the joint interaction graph, with a failing control.
honest_risks: (1) MEDIUM OWNERSHIP, the big one: the feasibility shape (sign-alternating in j) is manifestly the chain's parity structure — outcome (B) is live, and the instrument may prove only that a declared medium transmits a boundary condition, with the record's role reduced to setting a sign. The swap test in (B) is the guard, but if it is inconclusive the result is a field side of unresolvable ownership. (2) GAUGE NULLS: the Omega = 0 exact null shows whole regions of probe-parameter space where the instrument is structurally blind; other undetected isospectralities on other media could fake nulls — mitigated by C4 (every zero gets a positive control beside it) but not eliminated. (3) THE EARNED-SEPARATION EXTENSION MAY FAIL: on the joint venue, admissibility [U, H_tot] = 0 depends on lam and g, so d_sep may be coupling-dependent — arguably C-80's own lesson (reach belongs to the coupling) made literal, but then "away" is not coupling-independent and every separation claim carries that scope. (4) EXPONENTIAL SMALLNESS at scale: for a gapped medium the beyond-contact contrast likely decays exponentially in d_sep; resolvable at nB <= 10 exactly, but the instrument then says nothing about the large-separation regime where geometry is supposed to emerge — this instrument earns a FIELD SIDE, not the emergent field; conflating them would violate the anchor. (5) STATIC-ONLY: a nonzero E_ind is a mean-force (thermal equilibrium) statement — nothing dynamical deflects; the connection/deflection gap of O-39 stays open even under outcome (A), and the design says so rather than dressing E_ind as a metric. (6) The asymmetric bath fields needed to make the sector sign readable are declared, not earned — a critic can say the instrument's sensitivity was inserted; the m-sweep and which-record tests are the answer, and if they fail the sensitivity is confessed as inserted.
